rules.title: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases for RSO units are limited to 3% for July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026. From February 2, 2026, landlords may no longer add any additional percentage for utilities. RSO and SCEP surcharges may be passed through only after the units are registered and written notice is given.
rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.status_basis: Existing ordinance in force; page announces the annual allowable increase.
